note: Example registry. Copy to registry.json and fill real values locally; keep no secrets here. Slot times are KST.

experiment_kill_rule.window: first 14 uploads or 21 days after the first upload, whichever comes later
experiment_kill_rule.kill_if: median views per upload < 300 AND subscribers gained < 30 over the window
experiment_kill_rule.action: stop scheduling new uploads, keep published videos, report to CEO with the numbers
experiment_kill_rule.source: example; set the rule your team agreed
